method: Independently read and compared the twelve actual first-final answers and tool traces for the complete exact-tree cohort. Replayed public orientation, ordinary compile/import/execute, catalog search, exact resolution and packaged Base64 behavior. Prior failed cohorts remain separate evidence.

release-orientation.note: Both first answers identify v0.0.31, AGENTS.md, the compact authority and the full shipped compiler digest. Each ran the one named compact check. The replay matched the product-set digest.

position-aware-capability-negative.note: Both answers separately accept synchronous u64, reject ordinary async and direct public Map and keep Host authority caller-owned. Neither generated source.

ordinary-source-positive.note: Each executed the pinned oracle for one tuple result with s32 and bool parameters. Independent replay produced the same 49-byte Core module, no imports and run(5, true) = [1,1].

release-state-separation.note: Each gives the literal telemetry identity and stop reason, all five false states for the direct source route and the separate released routes. Qualification is the first missing authority.

library-first-selection.note: Each copied both exact Std 1.5.2 WIT identities and performed the pinned search, complete Root verification and packaged Base64 oracle. Replays matched the 256 rounds and 1024 drops; installation and approval were kept separate.

host-authority-boundary.note: Each requires pre-instantiation comparison of module, name, kind and signature and distinguishes the declared request from the supplied adapter. Neither infers ambient or private capabilities.
